tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Free. Statistics of the live bot (closed trades, win rate, live days, small_sample), a summary of the open book and the freshness of the data. Read this before paying.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free. Open positions and recent events delayed by 30 minutes, a sample of the paid data.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: PAID via x402 ($0.05 USDC). Live open positions with entry, stop loss, take profit, last price and the events of the last 24 hours. The call returns a payment-required error until an x402 payment is attached to the request _meta. You are charged only on success; stale data is refused and costs nothi

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: PAID via x402 ($0.25 USDC). The full event history of the live bot and its statistics. You are charged only on success.

tools.name: subscribe_follow
tools.description: PAID via x402 ($1.00 USDC). Returns a token valid for 24 hours. Pass it to follow_events and follow_state. You are charged only on success.

tools.name: follow_events
tools.description: With a follow token from subscribe_follow. New trading events with ids; pass the returned cursor as 'after' to continue. Act only on events with a small age_seconds.

tools.name: follow_state
tools.description: With a follow token from subscribe_follow. The bot's current positions, to reconcile your own book.
